title: Largest Integer With Given Digit Sum
summary: Given non-negative integers n and s, find the largest integer with at most n digits and a digit sum of s.
statement: Given non-negative integers n and s, find the largest integer with at most n digits and a digit sum of s. If no such integer exists, return -1.
constraints: Construct the largest nonnegative integer with at most n decimal digits and digit sum s.
Return -1 if s exceeds the capacity of n digits.
Return zero when s is zero.
hints: First reject sums larger than nine times n.
To maximize place value, put as much sum as possible into each earliest digit.
Greedy placement dominates any arrangement that moves value to a later place.
editorial: Greedy placement dominates any arrangement that moves value to a later place.

tests.explanation: Putting nine first and zero second produces the largest value 90.
Two digits can sum to at most eighteen, so no answer exists.
